title: MusicDrop v1.4.1 Available
changelog:
• True Edge-to-Edge Media Player: Video takes full available screen width and height without letterboxed card padding or purple gaps
• Docked Dark Sheet: Matching Screenshot 1 with drag handle, orange NOW PLAYING indicator, HD VIDEO badge, track title with navigation chevron, heart & download, orange scrubber, prominent white circular play button, and Save pill
• YouTube Video Fix: Fixed 'Video unavailable' error by applying Mobile Chrome UA and instant loadVideoById video switching for copyrighted music
• Dedicated Search Page & Search History: Instant navigation and query persistence across YouTube & local tracks
